title: Condorcet winner
statement: Let $w=(w_0,w_1,w_2)$ be the societal signs in the cyclic contests $a$ against $b$, $b$ against $c$, and $c$ against $a$. Candidate $a$ is a Condorcet winner exactly when $w_0=+1$ and $w_2=-1$; candidate $b$ is a Condorcet winner exactly when $w_0=-1$ and $w_1=+1$; candidate $c$ is a Condorcet winner exactly when $w_1=-1$ and $w_2=+1$.
hypotheses_covered: a sign outcome on the three cyclic pairwise contests
a candidate indexed by one of $0,1,2$
